company_name: Shanghai Xinyi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Shanghai Xinyi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in burn-in testing equipment for semiconductor chips, particularly in the 5G and automotive sectors.
summary: Shanghai Xinyi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures the Rockroll 1000 Logical Dynamic Burn-in Equipment, which is tailored for testing mid-to-high power ASIC chips. Their equipment supports various testing methodologies and is designed to ensure the electrical functional reliability of chips used in advanced applications such as AI and automotive technologies.
